name: Sharon
source:
A strange creature that protects the protagonist's innocence and saves the protagonist from assassins. Resembles a magical girl mascot. Has the appearance of a top-eared rabbit and uses a jetpack to move through the air.

[From the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2985830/XAngels_Artbook/]official artbook[/url]]
